players.product: AI GPU cloud (liquid + air-cooled data centers; 5 GW secured power, target 150k GPUs)

connects_to.relationship: AI cloud / liquid-cooled GPU capacity supplied to Microsoft (Horizon One, Childress)

contracts.signal: IREN announced on August 13, 2026 that Horizon 1 has been delivered to and accepted by Microsoft. Horizon 1 is the first of four 50MW (IT load) direct-to-chip liquid cooled AI Cloud deployments scheduled for delivery to Microsoft at IREN's Childress, Texas campus in 2026 under a five-year, $9.7bn cloud services contract announced in November 2025.
contracts.units: four 50MW (IT load) deployments; Horizon 1 delivered and accepted
